### Observed differences

- Six activities became mandatory: A36, A37, A42, A43, A44 and A27 each appeared in roughly half of the cases in the earlier window (48–54 in 100) and in every case in the later window, executed once per case (mean occurrences about 1.0). [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010]
- A27 and the group A36/A37/A42/A43/A44 were mutually exclusive in the earlier window (co-occurrence in 0–2 of 100 cases); in the later window they co-occur in every case, with the group preceding A27 in about 97–98 of 100. [REL042, REL043, REL044, REL045, REL046]
- A26's routing narrowed: about 46 in 100 of its observed outgoing transitions went to A27 in the earlier window (the rest mostly to the group members); in the later window about 98 in 100 go to A27. [DIR006, REL034]
- The group moved earlier (mean event position about 0.58 to about 0.41) and was re-anchored between A25 and A28: A25's dominant successor changed from A28 (98 of 100 outgoing transitions) to the group members (A37 24, A44 21, A42 20, A43 18, A36 13 of 100); the A25–A28 pair within five steps fell from 200 of 200 cases to 1 of 200; the order around A28 reversed (A28 preceded A36 in all co-occurrences before, A36 precedes A28 in about 98 of 100 after); and A31 is no longer the group's direct successor (A36 to A31 fell from about 22 to under 1 of 100 transitions, replaced by A28), while still following it. [POS009, POS010, POS011, POS012, POS013, DIR005, DIR007, DIR011, LAG009, LAG012, LAG014, LAG015, REL050, REL055]
- A02 became much more frequent and earlier: present in about 18 of 100 cases before and about 84 of 100 later (mean event position about 0.52 to 0.31); in the later window A47 leads to A02 in about 82 of 100 of its outgoing transitions (about 3 of 100 before) and A02 leads mostly to A20 (47) and A19 (37) of 100, with these pairs immediately adjacent in about 94–99 of 100 cases, whereas A47 previously led directly to A19 (44) and A20 (42) of 100. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR012, LAG001, LAG002, LAG016, LAG017, LAG018, REL013]
- A04, A06 and A10 became rarer, from about 16–20 of 100 cases to about 6–8 of 100. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- A26, A27 and A28 now occur at later positions in the case (mean event positions about 0.53 to 0.62, 0.59 to 0.64, and 0.39 to 0.49). [POS005, POS006, POS007]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that a choice between two branches was replaced by both branches running in sequence. In the earlier window, after A26 a case either continued to A27 (about 46 in 100 of A26's observed outgoing transitions) or entered the group A36/A37/A42/A43/A44 (about half of the transitions, in varying order), and A27 never co-occurred with the group; in the later window A26 leads almost exclusively to A27, the group runs in every case between A25 and A28 — A25 now feeds the group instead of A28, the direct A25–A28 adjacency has disappeared, and the group now precedes A28 and A26 whereas both previously preceded it — and A27 follows the group in essentially every case. The signs are consistent across indicator families: participation of all six activities rose from about half of cases to every case; relational items show exclusivity turning into universal co-occurrence with stable relative order (group before A27, A26 before A27, group before A28 and A31); directional and lag items show the same rerouting at A25, A26 and the group members. Screening found 145 qualifying items where about 1.36 would be expected without a change, so sampling chance cannot account for the ensemble. Limitations: the order inside the group shows both directions in similar shares in both windows, so no fixed internal sequence is established, and the evidence cannot show whether this restructuring and the A02 insertion reported below are one coordinated modification or two separate ones. [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR011, LAG009, LAG014, REL034, REL035, REL042, REL043, REL044, REL045, REL046, REL050, POS006, POS009, POS010, POS011, POS012, POS013]

Other differences: A02 became a near-mandatory step between A47 and A19/A20 — participation about 18 to 84 of 100 cases, A47 now leading to A02 (about 82 of 100 outgoing transitions, immediately adjacent in 99 of 100 pairs) and A02 immediately preceding A19 or A20 (about 94–99 of 100 pairs), replacing the earlier direct A47-to-A19/A20 transitions. A04, A06 and A10 appear in fewer cases (about 16–20 of 100 before, 6–8 of 100 after); their later-window estimates rest on only 11–15 traces, so those magnitudes are uncertain. A26, A27 and A28 occur at later event positions. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR012, LAG001, LAG002, LAG016, LAG017, LAG018, REL013, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, POS005, POS006, POS007]
